stages.title: EMPIRICIST STARTING RULE AND LOCKE-BERKELEY-HUME PRESSURE SEQUENCE

pills.text: EMPIRICIST STARTING RULE AND LOCKE-BERKELEY-HUME PRESSURE SEQUENCE
WHAT CAN EXPERIENCE ALONE JUSTIFY ABOUT WORLD, SELF, GOD
IDEAS; ACTIVE SPIRITS; NO MATTER PRESSURE
WHAT EXPERIENTIAL SOURCE SUPPORTS SELF AND NECESSARY POWER?

sequence: CENTRAL QUESTION: WHAT CAN EXPERIENCE ALONE JUSTIFY ABOUT WORLD, SELF, GOD AND CAUSE?
LOCKE: sensation + reflection → ideas → represented material world pressure: resemblance and unknown substratum
BERKELEY: sensible objects = ideas; active spirits; no matter pressure: what experiential source supports self
HUME: impressions + ideas → custom / natural belief → mitigated scepticism
ROUTE: representative realism → immaterialism → sceptical naturalism.

groups.heading: DOCTRINE / CLAIM
items: CENTRAL QUESTION: WHAT CAN EXPERIENCE ALONE JUSTIFY ABOUT WORLD, SELF, GOD AND CAUSE?
LOCKE: sensation + reflection → ideas → represented material world pressure: resemblance and unknown substratum

groups.heading: OBJECTION / PRESSURE
items: BERKELEY: sensible objects = ideas; active spirits; no matter pressure: what experiential source supports self and necessary power?
HUME: impressions + ideas → custom / natural belief → mitigated scepticism

groups.heading: REPLY / RESIDUAL
items: ROUTE: representative realism → immaterialism → sceptical naturalism.
CENTRAL QUESTION: WHAT CAN EXPERIENCE ALONE JUSTIFY ABOUT WORLD, SELF, GOD AND CAUSE?

stages.mechanism_strip: Each thinker applies experiential scrutiny to a claim preserved by the previous system: material support, active spirit, continuing self or necessary connection.
stages.answer_line: Empiricism is not three disconnected biographies but a progressive test of what an experience-only foundation can justify: Locke retains represented matter, Berkeley replaces matter with ideas and spirits, and Hume limits reason to perceptions, custom and mitigated belief.

stages.title: LOCKE'S SOURCE-OF-IDEAS PIPELINE AND LIMITS OF KNOWLEDGE

pills.text: LOCKE'S SOURCE-OF-IDEAS PIPELINE AND LIMITS OF KNOWLEDGE
NO UNIVERSAL ASSENT; NO CONSCIOUSLY UNPERCEIVED PROPOSITIONS

sequence: REJECT INNATE CONTENT: no universal assent; no consciously unperceived propositions
SENSATION (outer sense) + REFLECTION (mental operations)
SIMPLE IDEAS: passively received combine / compare / abstract
COMPLEX IDEAS: MODES
KNOWLEDGE: intuitive → demonstrative → sensitive; beyond it lies probability

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: REJECT INNATE CONTENT: no universal assent; no consciously unperceived propositions
SENSATION (outer sense) + REFLECTION (mental operations)

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: SIMPLE IDEAS: passively received combine / compare / abstract
COMPLEX IDEAS: MODES

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: KNOWLEDGE: intuitive → demonstrative → sensitive; beyond it lies probability
LIMIT: genetic explanation does not by itself defeat dispositional innatism.

stages.mechanism_strip: Experience supplies simple contents, after which mental operations build complex ideas without inventing any new simple sensory material.
stages.answer_line: Locke's empiricism is constructive rather than merely receptive: sensation and reflection provide simple ideas, while the understanding actively combines, compares and abstracts them into the complex materials of knowledge.

stages.title: LOCKE'S ABSTRACTION, GENERAL IDEAS AND REAL-NOMINAL ESSENCE

pills.text: LOCKE'S ABSTRACTION, GENERAL IDEAS AND REAL-NOMINAL ESSENCE

sequence: PARTICULAR IDEAS → omit time/place/concomitants → GENERAL REPRESENTATIVE
GENERAL WORD → signifies abstract general idea → classifies particulars
NOMINAL ESSENCE = abstract idea attached to the name
REAL ESSENCE = hidden internal constitution producing observable powers
TRIANGLE PROBLEM: neither equilateral nor scalene, yet represents both

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: PARTICULAR IDEAS → omit time/place/concomitants → GENERAL REPRESENTATIVE
GENERAL WORD → signifies abstract general idea → classifies particulars
NOMINAL ESSENCE = abstract idea attached to the name

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: REAL ESSENCE = hidden internal constitution producing observable powers
TRIANGLE PROBLEM: neither equilateral nor scalene, yet represents both
BERKELEY: no contradictory abstract image; use a particular sign generally

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: LOCKE REPLY: undetermined feature != contradictory feature
RESIDUAL: non-imagistic abstraction strains Locke's official idea theory.

stages.mechanism_strip: A particular experiential idea becomes general by selective omission and stands for a class under a general name.
stages.answer_line: Lockean abstraction makes generality a work of the understanding rather than a feature of independently existing universals, but Berkeley exposes the tension between a general determinable and an impossible indeterminate image.

stages.title: LOCKE'S QUALITIES, REPRESENTATIVE REALISM AND UNKNOWN SUBSTRATUM

pills.text: LOCKE'S QUALITIES, REPRESENTATIVE REALISM AND UNKNOWN SUBSTRATUM
SOLIDITY, EXTENSION, FIGURE, MOTION/REST, NUMBER; INSEPARABLE FROM BODY
COLOUR, SOUND, TASTE, SMELL, HEAT/COLD; POWERS RELATIVE TO PERCEIVERS
PRIMARY-QUALITY IDEAS RESEMBLE; SECONDARY-QUALITY IDEAS DO NOT

sequence: PRIMARY: solidity, extension, figure, motion/rest, number; inseparable from body
SECONDARY: colour, sound, taste, smell, heat/cold; powers relative to perceivers
RESEMBLANCE: primary-quality ideas resemble; secondary-quality ideas do not
BODY → causal action → IDEA IMMEDIATELY PERCEIVED → REPRESENTATION CLAIM
VEIL OBJECTION: how can an idea be compared with unperceived matter?
matrix: PRIMARY: solidity, extension, figure, motion/rest, number; inseparable from body
BODY → causal action → IDEA IMMEDIATELY PERCEIVED → REPRESENTATION CLAIM
EXACT LIMIT: 'something, I know not what' = unknown nature, not denied existence
SECONDARY: colour, sound, taste, smell, heat/cold; powers relative to perceivers
VEIL OBJECTION: how can an idea be compared with unperceived matter?
REPLY: causal/structural representation; RESIDUAL: support remains opaque.
RESEMBLANCE: primary-quality ideas resemble; secondary-quality ideas do not
SUBSTRATUM: supposed support of co-occurring qualities

groups.heading: SYSTEM / DOCTRINE
items: PRIMARY: solidity, extension, figure, motion/rest, number; inseparable from body
SECONDARY: colour, sound, taste, smell, heat/cold; powers relative to perceivers
RESEMBLANCE: primary-quality ideas resemble; secondary-quality ideas do not

groups.heading: DECISIVE DISTINCTION
items: BODY → causal action → IDEA IMMEDIATELY PERCEIVED → REPRESENTATION CLAIM
VEIL OBJECTION: how can an idea be compared with unperceived matter?
SUBSTRATUM: supposed support of co-occurring qualities

groups.heading: EVALUATION / TRAP
items: EXACT LIMIT: 'something, I know not what' = unknown nature, not denied existence
REPLY: causal/structural representation; RESIDUAL: support remains opaque.

stages.mechanism_strip: External bodies causally produce ideas; primary-quality ideas allegedly resemble their causes, while repeated co-instantiation motivates the supposition of a support.
stages.answer_line: Locke's representative realism secures an external world by the resemblance of primary-quality ideas, yet its unknown substratum and mediated perception generate the very gap that Berkeley turns against matter.

stages.title: LOCKE'S KNOWLEDGE, PROBABILITY, SELF, MEMORY AND DEMONSTRATIVE GOD

pills.text: LOCKE'S KNOWLEDGE, PROBABILITY, SELF, MEMORY AND DEMONSTRATIVE GOD
PERCEIVED AGREEMENT/DISAGREEMENT OF IDEAS; PROBABILITY GUIDES BELIEF
CONTINUITY OF CONSCIOUSNESS AND APPROPRIATION THROUGH MEMORY
SAMENESS OF MATERIAL OR IMMATERIAL BEARER

sequence: KNOWLEDGE = perceived agreement/disagreement of ideas; probability guides belief
SAME PERSON: continuity of consciousness and appropriation through memory
SAME HUMAN BEING: continuity of one living organism
SAME SUBSTANCE: sameness of material or immaterial bearer
PRINCE/COBBLER: person follows consciousness; man follows organism

groups.heading: DOCTRINE / CLAIM
items: KNOWLEDGE = perceived agreement/disagreement of ideas; probability guides belief
SAME PERSON: continuity of consciousness and appropriation through memory
SAME HUMAN BEING: continuity of one living organism

groups.heading: OBJECTION / PRESSURE
items: SAME SUBSTANCE: sameness of material or immaterial bearer
PRINCE/COBBLER: person follows consciousness; man follows organism
BUTLER: memory presupposes identity; REID: Brave Officer breaks transitivity

groups.heading: REPLY / RESIDUAL
items: REPAIR: overlapping psychological-continuity chains
GOD: finite knowing existence → demonstrative causal route; no innate God-idea
LIMIT: repaired continuity exceeds a simple episodic-memory criterion.

stages.mechanism_strip: Conscious appropriation links present and past experiences for accountability, while demonstrative reasoning moves from existing knowing being to an eternal powerful cause.
stages.answer_line: Locke's account unifies epistemic humility and forensic identity: knowledge has bounded degrees, while the person extends only as far as consciousness can appropriate past thought and action.

stages.title: BERKELEY'S ANTI-ABSTRACTION ROUTE TO IMMATERIALISM AND DIRECT REALISM

pills.text: BERKELEY'S ANTI-ABSTRACTION ROUTE TO IMMATERIALISM AND DIRECT REALISM
AN IDEA CAN BE LIKE ONLY AN IDEA
OBSERVER-RELATIVITY APPLIES TO PRIMARY AND SECONDARY QUALITIES

sequence: NO ABSTRACT GENERAL IMAGE → material substance-in-general loses content
LIKENESS PRINCIPLE: an idea can be like only an idea
QUALITY PARITY: observer-relativity applies to primary and secondary qualities
SENSIBLE OBJECT = stable collection of immediately perceived ideas
ESSE EST PERCIPI applies to sensible things; IDEAS are passive

groups.heading: DOCTRINE / CLAIM
items: NO ABSTRACT GENERAL IMAGE → material substance-in-general loses content
LIKENESS PRINCIPLE: an idea can be like only an idea
QUALITY PARITY: observer-relativity applies to primary and secondary qualities

groups.heading: OBJECTION / PRESSURE
items: SENSIBLE OBJECT = stable collection of immediately perceived ideas
ESSE EST PERCIPI applies to sensible things; IDEAS are passive
SPIRITS perceive and act; they are not themselves ideas

groups.heading: REPLY / RESIDUAL
items: DIRECT-REALIST DIMENSION: no unknowable material duplicate behind experience
TRAP: immaterialism denies matter, not experienced tables, trees or order.

stages.mechanism_strip: If all sensible qualities are ideas and no idea can resemble an unperceiving material original, matter adds no intelligible content to experienced objects.
stages.answer_line: Berkeley's immaterialism does not abolish experienced reality; it abolishes the unexperienced material duplicate behind it, turning anti-abstraction and the likeness principle into a direct-realist attack on Locke's representational veil.

stages.title: BERKELEY'S SPIRITS, GOD, WORLD-CONTINUITY AND OBJECTION LEDGER

pills.text: BERKELEY'S SPIRITS, GOD, WORLD-CONTINUITY AND OBJECTION LEDGER
FINITE SPIRITS RECEIVE INVOLUNTARY SENSORY IDEAS; IMAGINATION IS WEAKER/VOLUNTARY
PASSIVE IDEAS CANNOT CAUSE; ACTIVE CAUSATION BELONGS TO SPIRIT
INFINITE SPIRIT CAUSES STABLE, COHERENT AND SHARED SENSORY ORDER
OBJECT CONTINUITY DOES NOT DEPEND ON CONTINUOUS HUMAN OBSERVATION
ACTIVE SPIRIT KNOWN BY NOTION, NOT BY A COPIED
MANY FINITE SPIRITS + COMMON DIVINE ORDER

sequence: FINITE SPIRITS receive involuntary sensory ideas; imagination is weaker/voluntary
PASSIVE IDEAS cannot cause; active causation belongs to spirit
GOD / INFINITE SPIRIT causes stable, coherent and shared sensory order
OBJECT CONTINUITY does not depend on continuous human observation
SELF: active spirit known by NOTION, not by a copied idea

groups.heading: DOCTRINE / CLAIM
items: FINITE SPIRITS receive involuntary sensory ideas; imagination is weaker/voluntary
PASSIVE IDEAS cannot cause; active causation belongs to spirit
GOD / INFINITE SPIRIT causes stable, coherent and shared sensory order

groups.heading: OBJECTION / PRESSURE
items: OBJECT CONTINUITY does not depend on continuous human observation
SELF: active spirit known by NOTION, not by a copied idea
SOLIPSISM REPLY: many finite spirits + common divine order

groups.heading: REPLY / RESIDUAL
items: ILLUSION REPLY: coherence, involuntariness and correction within experience
RESIDUAL: experienced order does not uniquely demonstrate Berkeley's God.

stages.mechanism_strip: Involuntary, vivid and coherent sensory ideas form a law-like order whose active cause cannot be a passive idea and is attributed to God.
stages.answer_line: Berkeley avoids solipsism by making finite perceivers recipients within a divinely ordered language of nature: God is neither an idea nor another human observer but the active cause of stable sensory order.

stages.title: HUME'S IMPRESSIONS, IDEAS, FORK, SUBSTANCE, BUNDLE SELF AND RELIGION LIMITS

pills.text: HUME'S IMPRESSIONS, IDEAS, FORK, SUBSTANCE, BUNDLE SELF AND RELIGION
EVERY SIMPLE IDEA NORMALLY TRACES TO A SIMPLE IMPRESSION
MISSING SHADE OF BLUE IS A NARROW ACKNOWLEDGED EXCEPTION

sequence: PERCEPTIONS → IMPRESSIONS (forceful) / IDEAS (fainter copies)
COPY PRINCIPLE: every simple idea normally traces to a simple impression
QUALIFICATION: missing shade of blue is a narrow acknowledged exception
ASSOCIATION: resemblance
cause and effect

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: PERCEPTIONS → IMPRESSIONS (forceful) / IDEAS (fainter copies)
COPY PRINCIPLE: every simple idea normally traces to a simple impression
QUALIFICATION: missing shade of blue is a narrow acknowledged exception
ASSOCIATION: resemblance

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: cause and effect
HUME'S FORK: relations of ideas / matters of fact
SUBSTANCE: no distinct impression beyond a collection of qualities/perceptions
SELF: bundle in flux; memory/association generate identity fiction

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: APPENDIX DIFFICULTY: Hume cannot explain genuine unity among perceptions
GOD/RELIGION: design analogy and divine predicates exceed demonstrative certainty.

stages.mechanism_strip: Ideas inherit content from impressions; associative imagination connects them, but neither branch of the Fork supplies a perceived substance or a demonstrative inference to transcendent being.
stages.answer_line: Hume transforms empiricism into a forensic method: when substance, self or divine predicates cannot supply an originating impression or a valid inferential route, their speculative certainty is reduced without denying the natural beliefs of common life.

stages.title: HUME'S CAUSATION, INDUCTION AND CUSTOM LOOP

pills.text: HUME'S CAUSATION, INDUCTION AND CUSTOM LOOP
PRIORITY + CONTIGUITY + SUCCESSION; NO IMPRESSION OF NECESSARY
CONSTANT CONJUNCTION; OBJECTS REVEAL NO NEW TIE
FELT TRANSITION FROM A TO EXPECTED B
IMPRESSION OF REFLECTION PROJECTED ONTO OBJECTS

sequence: ONE CASE: priority + contiguity + succession; no impression of necessary power
REPETITION: constant conjunction; objects reveal no new tie
CUSTOM changes the mind → felt transition from A to expected B
NECESSITY = impression of reflection projected onto objects
CAUSE 1: regularly conjoined objects; CAUSE 2: one idea determines another

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: ONE CASE: priority + contiguity + succession; no impression of necessary power
REPETITION: constant conjunction; objects reveal no new tie
CUSTOM changes the mind → felt transition from A to expected B

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: NECESSITY = impression of reflection projected onto objects
CAUSE 1: regularly conjoined objects; CAUSE 2: one idea determines another
INDUCTION assumes future resembles past / nature is uniform

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: NO DEMONSTRATION: contrary is conceivable
NO NON-CIRCULAR EXPERIENCE PROOF: past success already uses induction
VERDICT: practice is natural and indispensable, but not rationally necessitated.

stages.mechanism_strip: Observed regularity conditions the imagination to move from cause-idea to effect-idea; the future is inferred from the past only by the very inductive principle under question.
stages.answer_line: Hume does not abolish causal reasoning; he relocates necessity from an observed tie in objects to the mind's customary transition, thereby exposing induction as naturally indispensable but rationally underdetermined.

stages.title: COMPARATIVE SYNTHESIS, SCEPTICISM, PYQ ROUTES AND ANSWER SPINE

pills.text: COMPARATIVE SYNTHESIS, SCEPTICISM, PYQ ROUTES AND ANSWER SPINE

sequence: LOCKE: matter retained / quality split / consciousness-self / demonstrative God
BERKELEY: no matter / all sensible qualities ideas / spirit-self / ordering God
HUME: no substance impression / perceptions / bundle-self / religion proof limits
SCEPTICISM: Locke limited realism
Berkeley anti-sceptical

groups.heading: SYSTEM / DOCTRINE
items: LOCKE: matter retained / quality split / consciousness-self / demonstrative God
BERKELEY: no matter / all sensible qualities ideas / spirit-self / ordering God
HUME: no substance impression / perceptions / bundle-self / religion proof limits
SCEPTICISM: Locke limited realism
Berkeley anti-sceptical

groups.heading: DECISIVE DISTINCTION
items: Hume mitigated
REALISM: representative != direct; IDEALISM != denial of experience
HUME: antecedent/excessive doubt rejected; custom/common life restore belief
PYQ ROUTES: innate ideas; identity; primary qualities; nominalism; Berkeley reality
PYQ ROUTES: Fork; causation; induction; bundle self; Kant response

groups.heading: EVALUATION / TRAP
items: ANSWER: directive → thesis → definitions → argument → objection/reply → verdict
CONTROL: claim → named text/example → analysis → qualification
VERDICT: empiricism disciplines certainty but cannot rationally ground every belief.

stages.mechanism_strip: Philosophical doubt exposes the limits of reason, while natural instinct and custom re-establish action under a disciplined, probabilistic standard of belief.
stages.answer_line: Hume's mature position is sceptical naturalism: reason cannot vindicate induction, substance, a simple self or natural theology with necessity, yet custom and common life inevitably restore proportioned belief.
